summary: SECOND retest (frontend only, LIVE prod DB, SAFE MODE) of invite->accept->login->view->revoke for company 1 'The Dev Store'. Sentinel dyno-rbac-verify+1788131419@example.com (member user_id=84) invited with only view_dashboard + view_transactions, accepted in a fresh context, verified, then REVOKED (DELETE /api/team/members/17 -> 200, 'No teammates yet'). RESULTS: FIX#3 STILL FAILS — a personal INDIVIDUAL company is STILL auto-created for the invitee (company-option-99 'Dyno RBAC Verify'), it is the DEFAULT workspace after accept (switcher read 'Dyno RBAC Verify', not 'The Dev Store'), and the onboarding wizard + "You're in! Your first payment is platform-fee-free" modal + 'Make your first sale' empty state all auto-appear. ROOT CAUSE FOUND (not the frontend suppression flag): backend userModel afterCreate hook registerAccountProvisioningHooks/ensurePersonalAccount (backend/services/accountProvisioning.ts) provisions a company for EVERY new tbl_user row, so acceptInvite's user creation triggers it — backend log at 23:11:17 'Provisioned personal account at signup {user_id:84, company_id:99}'. No POST /api/company/addCompany was ever made, so the sessionStorage 'dyno_suppress_onboarding' fix is working but is treating the wrong layer. FIX#4 MOSTLY PASSES — with The Dev Store selected the member's Dashboard now shows the OWNER's figures: 'This period' $929.46 / 20 payments (7D) which is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the owner's own dashboard on 7D, real (non-flat) VOLUME-7DAYS chart, PAYMENTS TODAY 3, ACTIVE WALLETS 13, no 'Make your first sale'. The ONLY remaining mismatch is the FEE TIER PROGRESS widget: member sees 'Monthly Volume $0 / $10,000 · Starter 1.5% · 0.0% complete' while the owner sees '$28,049.67 / $100,000 · Growth 1% · 28.0% complete' — GET /api/dashboard/fee-tiers (getFeeTiers, dashboardController.ts:698) is the one handler with NO validateCompanyOwnership and NO owner remap. Member Transactions PASSES (owner data: 'Showing 1-10 of 661 transactions', real USDT-TRC20/ERC20/ETH/BTC/LTC rows). Nav gating PASSES (8 items data-denied='true', permission tooltip, denied click does not navigate; Dashboard+Transactions enabled). Company switcher shows [data-testid='company-role-1']='Member' with no edit pencil for company 1. Revoke+audit PASSES (activity panel shows 'Removed a team member — just now' and 'Invited a team member — 12m ago').

critical.endpoint: userModel afterCreate hook -> ensurePersonalAccount (backend/services/accountProvisioning.ts) via POST /api/team/accept
critical.issue: Every new user row gets an auto-provisioned personal INDIVIDUAL company, including team invitees created by acceptInvite. Confirmed in backend log: 'Provisioned personal account at signup {user_id:84, company_id:99}' at the exact accept timestamp, with zero company/addCompany API calls. This is the real cause of FIX#3 failing; the frontend sessionStorage suppression cannot prevent it. Suggested fix: skip provisioning when the user is created by acceptInvite (pass a hook option/flag, e.g. userModel.create({...}, { skipAccountProvisioning: true }) and honour it in the hook, or skip when the user has an active tbl_team_member row).

minor.issue: getFeeTiers (dashboardController.ts:698) never calls validateCompanyOwnership and never remaps userId to the company owner (all other dashboard handlers now do). Member sees their own $0/Starter tier for company 1 instead of the owner's $28,049.67/Growth, and there is no 403 for a non-granted company_id. Additionally the Redis cacheKey `feeTiers:${userId}:${company_id}` is built from the pre-remap user id — after adding the remap it must be keyed by (effectiveOwnerId, companyId, currency) to avoid cache bleed.

ui_bugs.issue: After accepting, [data-testid='company-selector-trigger'] reads 'Dyno RBAC Verify' (the auto-created INDIVIDUAL company, [data-testid='company-option-99'], with an edit pencil) instead of 'The Dev Store'. Switcher shows 2 options: company-option-99 (Individual, owned) and company-option-1 (Business, Member). The member must switch manually before gating/owner data appear.

On the invitee's first dashboard load the "You're in! Your first payment is platform-fee-free" modal auto-pops plus the wizard rows (Complete your account details / Add a payout wallet / Create your first payment link / Receive your first payment) and 'Make your first sale' empty state. The 'dyno_suppress_onboarding' flag does stop company auto-creation from the wizard, but the modal/wizard still render because the auto-provisioned company makes the invitee look like a brand-new merchant.

ui_bugs.component: Member dashboard — FEE TIER PROGRESS card
ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Monthly Volume $0/$10,000 · Starter 1.5% · $10,000 to next tier' for a company whose owner is at '$28,049.67/$100,000 · Growth 1%'. Contradicts the (now correct) volume/chart/KPI numbers on the same screen.

Revoke uses the browser-native window.confirm('Remove <email> from this business?') instead of an MUI confirm dialog — inconsistent with the rest of the app and it silently no-ops in automation (Playwright auto-dismisses native dialogs), which initially looked like a broken button. Recommend an MUI Dialog with data-testid (e.g. team-remove-confirm).

ui_bugs.component: Member chrome (regression from iteration_104, still open)
ui_bugs.issue: With The Dev Store selected the member still sees the merchant banner 'Your first payment: 0% platform fee ... Start accepting payments' and the header chip 'Complete wallet setup'.

integration_issues.flow: invite -> accept -> member login -> view granted business -> revoke
integration_issues.issue: End-to-end works: accept 200, plus-addressed email login OK, Member badge, 8/8 denied nav items, owner's 661 transactions, owner's dashboard KPIs/chart, revoke DELETE 200 + audited. Residual gaps: auto-created personal company is the default workspace, and the fee-tier widget is not owner-scoped.

issues: Fee-tier card ($0/Starter) contradicts the volume card ($929.46 / 20 payments) and PAYMENTS TODAY 3 on the same page
Merchant onboarding banner + 'Complete wallet setup' chip shown to a view-only teammate

action_items: FIX#3 (real fix, backend): stop ensurePersonalAccount from firing for invite-created users — add a skip flag from teamController.acceptInvite's userModel.create (or skip when an active tbl_team_member row exists for that email), then default the selected workspace to the granted (is_member) company.
FIX#4 (last gap): add validateCompanyOwnership + owner remap to getFeeTiers (dashboardController.ts:698) and rekey its Redis cache to the effective owner id.
Suppress the onboarding wizard / 'first payment platform-fee-free' modal / 'Your first payment: 0% platform fee' banner / 'Complete wallet setup' chip in member context.
Replace window.confirm in TeamSettingsSection.revoke() with an MUI confirm dialog carrying data-testids.

DB cleanup (UI cannot do it): sentinel user_id=84 dyno-rbac-verify+1788131419@example.com and its auto-created company_id=99 'Dyno RBAC Verify' (INDIVIDUAL). Team membership id 17 already revoked, so it has no access to company 1.
critical_code_review_comments: accountProvisioning's userModel afterCreate hook is a global side-effect on user creation with no opt-out; any non-merchant signup path (team invite, admin-created user, future SSO guest) silently gets a company. Give ensurePersonalAccount an explicit call site or a documented skip option instead of a blanket hook.

The effective-owner remap is still per-controller (7 of 8 dashboard handlers do it, getFeeTiers does not). Centralise it in a resolveEffectiveOwner middleware bound to company_id so no read route can be missed.
Dashboard/fee-tier Redis cache keys are per-user while the data is company-scoped — key by (effectiveOwnerId, companyId, currency).

success_rate.frontend: 5 of 6 review items pass (~83%): FIX#3 FAIL (root cause identified), FIX#4 PASS except fee-tiers widget, member transactions PASS, nav gating PASS, revoke+audit PASS, cleanup PASS in-app (2 prod rows need DB cleanup)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://setup-vault-6.preview.emergentagent.com . Each browser_automation call starts a FRESH context, so re-login in every script. Selector gotchas: login-email-input / password-input are real <input>s; MUI dialog fields need nested input ([data-testid='team-invite-email'] input, [data-testid='team-invite-link'] input, [data-testid='accept-invite-name'] input, [data-testid='accept-invite-password'] input); permission switches [data-testid='team-perm-<key>'] input (click force); accept-invite-submit twice -> .last. IMPORTANT: revoke uses a NATIVE window.confirm — in async Playwright you MUST register page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept())) (a bare d.accept() returns an un-awaited coroutine, the page then hangs and no DELETE fires). Compare member vs owner on the SAME date range (7D): owner 7D = $929.46 / 20 payments, so member $929.46 is CORRECT; the real owner-vs-member discrepancy to watch is the FEE TIER card ($0/Starter vs $28,049.67/Growth). Never wait for networkidle; 8-12s waits after login/company switch.
rca_of_the_issue: FIX#3: backend/services/accountProvisioning.ts registers a userModel afterCreate hook (registerAccountProvisioningHooks, called from backend/server.ts:39) that calls ensurePersonalAccount for every newly created user; TEST_EMAIL_SUFFIXES only skips @dynopaytest.com/@dynopay-test.com/@dyno.pt, so an invitee created inside teamController.acceptInvite gets an INDIVIDUAL company (log: user_id=84 -> company_id=99). CompanyDataContext then defaults to that owned company, which also makes the onboarding wizard/first-payment modal render. The frontend 'dyno_suppress_onboarding' flag works (no POST /api/company/addCompany was made) but cannot prevent a server-side provisioning hook. FIX#4: only getFeeTiers still filters tbl_user_transaction by req.user.id with no company-ownership remap, so the member's fee tier is computed from their own (empty) history.
